text: Launched CL27 (post cl27-a-full-ui-and-ux-audit-of-the-board-then): first a full audit, visual and in code, on phone (with the keyboard open) and desktop, light and dark, every view, each problem with a picture and its cause, yours first; then every fix with a measure that fails before. It asks you only taste choices (e.g. what the trains view becomes), with pictures. Attached to the board repo this time.
